body.message:
Good morning. As the hot water issue remains unresolved and there is still no confirmed timeframe from DAMAC for restoring it, I have reconsidered my position.

I appreciate that Fam Living has been following up, but we have now been without a basic essential service for several days and I no longer want to continue the stay under these circumstances.

I would therefore like to agree an early termination of the remaining stay without penalty, with no further rental payments becoming due and a refund of any amount already paid for the unused period.

I have also raised the matter with Airbnb and would prefer that we resolve this amicably between us. Please escalate this to management and confirm today how we can arrange the early termination and handover.
